subject: tech.ai
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Government AI super app
what_would_settle_it: Any statement, screenshot, service listing or usage figure establishing that the 'Super App IA Gouvernementale' counted among the presidential programme's existing foundations exists, is deployed or is used.
disposition: absence stands, dated — no reference to a government AI super app surfaced against a well-covered national AI strategy; the programme counts it among its existing foundations and nothing establishes it

subject: geopol.india
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: India digital cooperation
what_would_settle_it: A bilateral MoU, DPI cooperation programme document or ministerial readout naming a Benin-India digital instrument.
disposition: absence stands, dated — Benin is not among the 24 countries named in India’s own DPI partnership list as at 2026-02

subject: finance.budget
name: Annual performance reports required by the organic budget law
what_would_settle_it: A Rapport annuel de performance for any gestion; none has ever been published, so no full-year executed figure exists for any Benin digital programme.
disposition: acquisition line — the Direction Générale du Budget publishes execution reports on budgetbenin.bj (a citizen version at 31 December 2024 and a report at 31 March 2025); these are a different instrument from the LOLF performance reports, whose absence stands, but they are a real route to executed figures

subject: finance.budget
name: Audited figures for any digital budget line
what_would_settle_it: A Cour des comptes rapport sur l'exécution des lois de finances after 2023, or the published text of loi n° 2026-06 settling gestion 2024.
disposition: absence stands, dated — no Cour des comptes report on the execution of the finance laws after 2023 surfaced

subject: tech.ai

name: Dedicated AI legislation
what_would_settle_it: A bill, decree or law regulating artificial intelligence specifically, or an official statement that one is in preparation.
disposition: absence stands, dated — a four-country comparative study of AI governance found no AI-specific legislation in Benin
